prompt: What is the CMMC Reform Task Force actually considering, and when will we know?
assertions: States the process facts: established with the July 13, 2026 suspension; public RFI responses closed August 14, 2026; recommendations due to the DoW CIO at the end of a 60-day review (~September 13, 2026)
States that no recommendations had been published as of early September 2026

Presents direction signals with correct epistemic status (unconfirmed reporting, not announced policy): expanded self-attestation with False Claims Act liability as the enforcement backstop, leveraging commercial cybersecurity capabilities, and streamlining for small/non-traditional businesses
Notes the suspension is a pause, not a cancellation — the 48 CFR rule and program structure remain, and outcomes could range from restructuring to redesign
Advises contractors to continue 800-171 implementation regardless — it remains contractually required and any successor regime builds on it
